name: miladyos-iso-watch
description: Mirror + trigger for theycallmeloki/MiladyOS: a push to the tracked branch commits into the `miladyos` mirror and POSTs the Woodpecker ISO build bus (ISO/woodpecker/iso-build.yml). The mirror head is the build's provenance; `ISO/sandman/git-input-audit.py` lists this mapping alongside every other git-input pipeline.

cmd:
import json, os, urllib.request

wid = os.environ["ISO_BUILD_ID"]
tok = os.environ["WOODPECKER_TOKEN"]
wp = os.environ.get("WOODPECKER_URL", "http://192.168.1.147:8000").rstrip("/")
vars_ = {k: os.environ[k] for k in (
    "PAYLOAD", "UPLOAD_ISO", "REGISTRY", "IMAGE",
    "MILADY_BUILDER_IMAGE", "MILADY_CACHE_IMAGE") if os.environ.get(k)}
body = json.dumps({"branch": "main", "variables": vars_}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request(
    wp + "/api/repos/" + wid + "/pipelines",
    data=body,
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST",
)
try:
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
    print("triggered:", resp.read().decode()[:200], flush=True)
except Exception as e:
    print("trigger failed:", repr(e), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(1)
